-# Hello-World
### [github created Dependabot alert **#5** for **rack**: Rack vulnerable to Denial of Service via crafted multipart requests](https://github.com/Codertocat/Hello-World/security/dependabot/5)
There is a possible DoS vulnerability in the multipart parser in Rack before 2.0.6. Specially crafted requests can exploit this.
